name: Hand Maid
source:
Main character returns to a previous work in a Western-style mansion after a long absence. He receives a challenge from his master's friend to train the best maid out of a usual woman. He takes up the challenge.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公久违地回到了前作的西式宅邸。他收到了主人的朋友的挑战，要从一个普通的女人中培养出最好的女仆。他接受了挑战。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
